_about: MotorGo Plink v1 as a routing benchmark (tools/bench/plink_signals.py writes this). The board is the designer's; the bench keeps its placement and pours and re-routes. Currents are assumptions: 1.5 A per channel, 1.5 A into the buck.

policy._why: the designer's own setup: JLC 4-layer minimums

+5V.source: U6 TPS54620 through D4, or USB VBUS

signals._about: SIG-1 for the Plink: driver edge per net with the source of the number; `pcb signals` computes knee and bucket. Every rise time is a stated assumption except USB full speed (spec 4-20 ns) and the DRV8874 OUTx 150 ns.

m2_EN.source: assumption: ESP32-S3 GPIO, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns at the default drive strength

m2_PH.source: assumption: ESP32-S3 GPIO, 3.3 V CMOS edge 3 ns at the default drive strength

Net-(U3-IPROPI).driver: U3.6 IPROPI current mirror into Rp1 4.87k
Net-(U3-IPROPI).source: follows the bridge current, which steps at the OUTx edge (DRV8874 tRISE 150 ns); weak aggressor
Net-(U3-IPROPI).note: analog, 4.87k source impedance, ADC input on U1

Net-(U3-nFAULT).driver: U3.4 open-drain (fall); R10 10k pull-up to +5V (rise); nSLEEP tied to it
Net-(U3-nFAULT).source: assumption: DRV8874 open-drain pull-down into ~20 pF, 20 ns; rise is the RC

Net-(U3-CPH).driver: U3.13 charge-pump switch into C5 22 nF
Net-(U3-CPH).source: no edge spec; slew bound by I/C, tens of mA into 22 nF over ~5 V >= 2 us; fVCP 400 kHz

Net-(U3-CPL).driver: U3.14 charge-pump switch into C5 22 nF

Net-(U3-VCP).driver: U3.12 VCP into C3 100 nF (VM + ~5 V)
